question: Which set of Articles in the Constitution of India are known as ‘Cultural and Educational Rights’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Articles 29-30**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 29:** Protection of Interests of Minorities by providing them the right to conserve their culture, language, and script.
 
• No citizen shall be denied admission into any educational institution maintained by the state or receiving aid out of state funds, on grounds of discrimination.
 
• **Article 30:** Rights of Minorities to Establish and Administer Educational Institutions of their choice.
 
• The state shall not discriminate against **any educational institution **on the grounds that it is under the management of a minority.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 23:** Prohibition of Traffic in Human Beings and Forced Labour.
 
• **Article 24:** Prohibition of Employment of Children in Factories, etc.
 
• **Article 14: **Guarantees that all individuals are equal before the law and are entitled to equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
 
• **Article 15: **Prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
 
• **Article 19: **Guarantees six freedoms to the citizens of India. These are indispensable for the functioning of a democratic society.
 
• 
 
**Article 20: **Provides protection to individuals in case of convictions for offenses, ensuring the rule of law in criminal justice
